tools.name: find_spots
tools.description: Lists Siami's snowboard, ski, kitesurf, diving and surf spots by sport, country and area (region, province, island or town), alphabetically, with the place, the country, the sports of each spot and its page. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

tools.name: get_spot
tools.description: One spot's page on Siami: sports, place and country, other names, season, how it is today for each sport (the website's rating, a 1-5 score and the reasons, from Open-Meteo), the current wind, snow or sea, the spot's features (lifts, slopes, altitudes, beach, dive site…) and its official links. tools.description: The forecast of a spot for the next days, as its page shows it: for each day, sunrise and sunset, tides and kite hours where they apply, and for the morning, afternoon and night the sky, temperatures (top, middle and base of ski resorts), wind and gusts with direction, chance of rain, snowfall, free

tools.name: best_spots_today
tools.description: Where conditions are best today, tomorrow or this weekend (Siami's “Where it's best” on /weather): spots ranked by their 1-5 score, with the website's rating and the wind, snow or waves of each, optionally for one sport, one country or around a spot. tools.name: find_businesses
tools.description: Schools, rentals, shops, dive centres, guides, surf camps and clubs listed on Siami's harbour, near a spot (by distance) or in a country, optionally for one sport and one kind, with what you can do there (buy, book, rent, train) and their page. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: The countries with spots on Siami, most spots first, with how many spots each has per sport and the page that lists them. Optionally only for one sport. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

tools.name: find_events
tools.description: Snowboard, ski, kitesurf, diving and surf competitions on Siami: upcoming (default) or past, optionally for one sport, one country, around a spot or by words in the title, with dates, venue, series and their page. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches Siami by name, without accents or capitals: spots (by name or place), schools and shops, athletes (their sport, country and best-known result) and upcoming events, each with a line of context and its page. Use it when you are not sure of a name. Responds in the requested language (lang: es,

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
